scope: Source-faithful player-visible interaction presentation layered on canonical gameplay state
rules: A successful state mutation alone is insufficient for interaction fidelity.
Presentation must be driven by source-backed per-object evidence; missing content must HOLD rather than invent text or art.
Pickup/read flows preserve DemoState as the canonical inventory and save/load source.
World interaction cursor, modal presentation, close input, inventory visibility and post-close cursor state are independently validated.
acceptance: r1p1 is removed/deactivated from its authored R1 location, added to carried state/UI, then opens the source book presentation.
the original readable presentation is shown only after its exact source content has been identified and bound.
no placeholder transcription, modern dialog, invented parchment art or guessed close behavior is accepted.
PPPV records both canonical state change and presentation-open/presentation-close observations.
